text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Thrilled and giving it her all, Ines Fujin 
runs through the Asahi Hai FS. As a 
result, she collapses after the race.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It seemed her all-out race had ignited a 
fire in the hearts of many spectators and 
rivals alike.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Her next goal is the Satsuki Sho on the 
Classic Triple Crown route, leading to the 
Japanese Derby. Ines Fujin is sure to draw 
plenty of attention as well.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The way people around Ines Fujin viewed 
her began to change as well. Her workplace 
suggested to her, "Why not focus solely on 
racing?"

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Ines Fujin wanted to keep working 
part-time to support her sisters... yet 
she was also curious about her Trainer's 
thoughts on the matter.
